column5: What if Venom took over Superman?
The symbiote makes every power stronger.
And he was already faster than a bullet.
He doesn't save the city anymore.
Even kryptonite might not reach him.
But the symbiote has two weaknesses.
One clap is a sonic boom.
It chose the one body it can't survive.
Superman's first comic, from 1938, sold for six million dollars.
